$comment: JSON Schema (informal, not enforced) for supporters.json. The build script validates against this.

supporters_entry.name: string — full name as donor wants it shown (or 'Anonymous')
supporters_entry.amount_usd: number — exact amount in USD (used only to compute tier; not displayed publicly)
supporters_entry.comment: string? — optional 1-line comment from donor; max 200 chars; shown as a quote below the name
supporters_entry.claimed_talk: boolean? — true if the $20+ donor has scheduled their 30-min talk
